title: Lee Theatre
scope: The exterior of the original Lee Theatre, Causeway Bay, as mapped in 1975 before its 1991 closure, including its chamfered entrance, tower, classically dressed street elevations, and large rear auditorium.
limitations: This dated exterior uses the 1975 historical wall outlines and a second survey from 1989. The modern Lee Theatre Plaza is outside scope. The placement interval covers the surveyed theatre and ends after the last August 1991 performance.

Wall heights, roof profile, number of columns, window shapes, lettering, ornament and exact facade tones are interpretive. The documented domed auditorium informs one low domed roof, and the entry tower is a distinct smaller feature.
Original Hong Kong Lands Department terrain provides modern bare-earth geometry and a street-level datum. Historic paving, landscaping, steps and adjacent buildings are approximated or outside scope.
